title: 13th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَالْاَقْذَارِ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) purify me against filth and dirt,
grant me on this day steadfastness against vicissitudes of time,
lead me on this day to piety and companionship of the upright ones,
in the name of Your assistance, O delight of the poor!
